as_told.title: JC's 'sound, light and frequency' formula written on an envelope

plain: On September 21, 1996, in the Los Angeles backyard of the television writer Bryce Zabel, a man known as JC scribbled a formula on an ATM deposit envelope in about 30 seconds and told the screenwriter Brent Friedman to keep it in a safety deposit box for 10 to 15 years, saying that if they never made a deal, "you'll know I was for real." Friedman, who was there and says Zabel was too, says it looked like an incomprehensible formula, and when he asked what it was, JC answered: "sound, light and frequency, secrets of the universe." If true, a stranger handed Hollywood writers what he claimed was a key to how the universe works.
